notes.title: Gemmiferous v0.6.1.2 - Hotfix
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]A small hotfix has just been released to address several issues reported by users[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixes include:[/b][/p][list][*][p]UI: The new savefile window now properly closes after clicking “Yes.”[/p][/*][*][p]UI: Various minor interface issues have been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolution: Corrected 2560x1440 option.[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial: Starting a new savefile no longer keeps the tutorial still as completed.[/p][/*][*][p]Stone Mine: Production now starts correctly after purchase.[/p][/*][*][p]Shop: Duplicate relics are no longer shown if already in your inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Combat: Hit damage numbers are now larger for better visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Gameplay: Piece swaps are correctly registered even if the mouse moves outside the board.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you all for reporting these issues so quickly! Your feedback helps me keep Gemmiferous better then ever.[/p][p][/p][p][i]jslovieDev[/i][/p]

notes.title: Gemmiferous v0.6.1.1 - Hotfix
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]
I've just released a small hotfix to address a couple of issues from the recent update.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Corrected a GUI issue where particle effects on matched pieces displayed in the wrong order.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where music was unintentionally dimmed or muted when it shouldn’t have been.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for reporting these problems so quickly! notes.title: Gemmiferous v0.6.1.0 - Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]The v0.6.1.0 update focuses on enhancing the overall player experience through refined user interface improvements, upgraded audio design, gameplay adjustments, and comprehensive balance changes. Our goal with this patch is to create a smoother, more accessible experience while maintaining the depth and challenge that define Gemmiferous.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45499500/25a18154447fac3df1b4b7fbabb014a5757c6930.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]User Interface[/h2][list][*][p]Implemented a series of UI refinements to improve clarity, readability, and responsiveness.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced menu navigation to ensure a more streamlined user experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated in-game feedback elements to better communicate player actions and status changes.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Audio[/h2][list][*][p]Rebalanced in-game sound effects to achieve greater consistency across all gameplay scenarios.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved audio clarity and variation for core interactions, enhancing overall immersion.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced subtle audio cues to reinforce important gameplay events and player feedback.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Gameplay & Balance[/h2][list][*][p]Adjusted difficulty scaling to provide a more accessible entry point for new players while preserving strategic depth for experienced players.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced enemy encounters and resource distribution to create a fairer progression curve.[/p][/*][*][p]Refined pacing of key gameplay loops to reduce spikes in difficulty and improve overall flow.[/p][/*][*][p]General balance tuning across multiple systems to ensure consistency and fairness.[/p][/*][/list][h2]General Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Optimized underlying systems to improve performance and stability.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes and polish to support a smoother gameplay experience.[/p][/*][/list]
